target.name: counter-protocol
target.environment: Integer arithmetic; one request per process

requirements.statement: Reset makes the counter zero and returns zero.
Adding an integer changes the counter by that integer and returns the new value. Each request starts at zero.

interfaces.name: counter-sequence
interfaces.inputs: An object with ops, an array of objects with op reset or add. Add includes integer value.
interfaces.outputs: An array of returned integer values in operation order.
interfaces.errors: Invalid operations are outside this fictional contract.

exclusions: Malformed input and persistence across processes
unknowns: Overflow limits of a future fixed-width port
